newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech insurer approves rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Czech insurer approves rights issue.

text.p: An extraordinary general meeting of the largest Czech insurer, Ceska Pojistovna a.s., has approved a rights issue of new common shares worth a total nominal value of 1.14 billion crowns, the local CTK agency reported on Thursday.
The nominal 1,000 crown shares will be offered at 5,000 crowns to current shareholders.
The premium from the equity expansion will be used to cover liabilities stemming from the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s. in which Pojistovna owns a majority stake.
Pojistovna shares were trading 200 crowns lower at 3,800 crowns in the daily price fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange.
If fully subscribed the new issue would raise Pojistovna's basic capital to 3.412 billion crowns.

Pojistovna's major shareholders include the private investment fund PPF, the banks Komercni Banka a.s., Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s., and Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s., and the state-run National Property Fund.
